pr_title: lib: os: mpsc_pbuf: Fix infinite loop during allocation
pr_body:
It was possible that allocation was continuously attempting to find space. It could happen if allocation interrupted consuming a packet (which is marked as busy) and there is not enough space to allocate requested packet but there would be if busy packet was freed. Algorithm in that case was continuously going through the buffer in search for packets that can be dropped to find space for the new packet.

Fixes #84286.
pr_comments: @nordic-krch so much for fixing typos, you now have a conflict and this needs rebasing, boohooh.

issue_context.title: Deferred logging causes calling thread to hang when log buffer is full
issue_context.body:
When I use deferred logging on a STM32 Nucleo L452RE-P board and the log buffer fills up, the thread that calls the LOG_* function hangs.

I can reproduce the behaviour with the following simple program:

```
#include <zephyr/kernel.h>
#include <zephyr/logging/log.h>
#include <zephyr/drivers/gpio.h>

LOG_MODULE_REGISTER(main, CONFIG_LOG_DEFAULT_LEVEL);

// use large message size to fill up the log buffer
#define MSG_SIZE (CONFIG_LOG_BUFFER_SIZE/2)
#define LED0_NODE DT_ALIAS(led0)

int main(void)
{
	static char msg[MSG_SIZE];   // static because large buffer might not fit on stack

	for (int i = 0; i < sizeof(msg); ++i) {
		msg[i] = '.';
	}
	msg[sizeof(msg)-1] = '\0';

	const struct gpio_dt_spec led = GPIO_DT_SPEC_GET(LED0_NODE, gpios);

	if (!gpio_is_ready_dt(&led)) {
		return 0;
	}

	if (gpio_pin_configure_dt(&led, GPIO_OUTPUT_ACTIVE) < 0) {
		return 0;
	}

	while (1) {
		gpio_pin_set_dt(&led, 1);
		LOG_INF("%s", msg);
		k_msleep(500);
		gpio_pin_set_dt(&led, 0);
		k_msleep(500);
	}

	return 0;
}
```

The test program is supposed to continuously log a large message (half the log buffer size) in order to fill up the log buffer.  It sets and clears the LED to indicate that it is still alive.  However when I run the program on the board the LED stays lit on the third iteration, indicating that it is hanging inside `LOG_INF`.

project configuration:
```
CONFIG_GPIO=y

CONFIG_LOG=y
CONFIG_LOG_MODE_DEFERRED=y
CONFIG_LOG_BUFFER_SIZE=128

#CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=n
```

(you can ignore the `CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=n` line for now; I disable `CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK` further down to get additional log messages from the `mpsc` module).

It happens on both the latest Zephyr revision  (`09991d526a58f8a51ed9c59480b98a4f30c2053d`)  and also on Zephyr 3.6.0.

The LED stays lit on the third iteration (same as with the Nucleo board).

(edit: added console output with `MPSC_PBUF_DEBUG` enabled)

So it looks like if the log process thread is able to `claim` a message from the buffer and gets preempted while it is sending the message over the UART, then it somehow is not able to `free` the message again (maybe because it does not get scheduled anymore?)

This causes the main task to stay stuck in `mpsc_pbuf_alloc` (as seen by the neverending sequence of "no space: Found busy packet" and "no space: Found skip packet" messages).

Or the main task is stuck in `mpsc_pbuf_alloc` for some reason and this prevents the log process thread to be scheduled.
